title: Bumpy road
instructions: A function gives a name to a group of commands, so you can use them again like a new command. Finish bump(), then use it to drive the whole road in 9 commands or fewer.
note: void means the function does something but doesn't give back a number.
hint: A bump goes up 1, over the top, down 1, and then turns to face along the road again. The flat parts between bumps are 2 cells long. Commands inside bump() count once, no matter how many times you use it.
